description: Isolated test of q_t: B3's (action, observation, q_t) stream is replayed through B4's belief update on the same student. Δ(B4-B3) > 0 ⇒ q_t weight degrades inference on this stream.

guesser.interpretation: q_t correctly downweights noise: observations under this behaviour carry little mastery information; downweighting stabilises the belief.

copier.interpretation: q_t over-downweights informative correctness signal: behaviour flag triggers downweight even when the observation itself carries valid mastery-correlated information.
